purpose: Continue only the root-pilot fixed character-Ridge blend to the four remaining primary temporal windows.
model: Existing CharacterRidge recipe: hybrid structured preprocessing + char_wb TF-IDF ngrams 3-5, min_df 3, max_features 30000, sublinear_tf, Ridge alpha and solver unchanged from the existing hybrid_ridge recipe.
rank_mapping: Within each validation cycle, average rank (ties=average) maps to 100*rank/n. rank50=clip(0.5*raw_character_prediction + 0.5*rank_percentile, 0, 100).
h12: Reuse cutoff 55 character predictions for cycles 56-67 and cutoff 67 predictions for cycles 68-79. Do not refit.
control: Reconstruct the frozen V3 champion from the original row-aligned V2 caches through scripts/optimization_v3_reg_diagnostics.py:_build_view; preserve its 0.5625 LGB-SVD32 + 0.1875 Hybrid Ridge + 0.25 sparse-LGB rank50 recipe.
evaluation: Report MAE, RMSE, signed bias, equal-cycle MAE, per-cycle metrics, tails, EF0/EF1, stream-present/missing, fit-defined numeric/category groups, subgroup MAE harm, and fit-defined character vocabulary size.
guardrail: No supported subgroup (n>=100) may have candidate MAE harm over 0.25, across each reported primary/H12 view. Smaller groups remain visible and descriptive.
interpretation: All temporal cycles have been used in adaptive development; report results as comparative development evidence, not an untouched holdout estimate. Target-defined tails are post-prediction diagnostics only.
